text: After a mental-health crisis or hospital discharge, stay in touch with your teen and follow their care team's plan: listen without blame, review appointments and the safety plan, and say: you matter to me; I am with you. If self-harm risk returns, call emergency services.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance.
